items.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
items.content: Meet GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API input and output token prices.
items.contentSnippet: Meet GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API input and output token prices.

summaries.zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 是一款接近 Astra 智能水平的人工智能模型，适用于编程、计算机使用和专业人士工作。其标准 API 输入和输出代币价格仅为 Astra 的五分之一。
summaries.en: GPT-6.1 Sol is introduced as a near-Astra intelligence model designed for coding, computer use, and professional tasks. It offers significant cost advantages, providing performance comparable to Astra while using only one-fifth of the standard API input and output token prices.

items.summary: GPT-6.1 Sol 是一款接近 Astra 智能水平的人工智能模型，适用于编程、计算机使用和专业人士工作。其标准 API 输入和输出代币价格仅为 Astra 的五分之一。

items.title: Introducing dots
items.content: Dots by OpenAI are proactive assistants that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in control while work moves forward.
items.contentSnippet: Dots by OpenAI are proactive assistants that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in control while work moves forward.

summaries.zh: OpenAI的Dots是一款主动式助手，能在复杂项目和日常任务中持续工作。它帮助用户在任务推进时保持掌控力。
summaries.en: "Dots by OpenAI is a proactive assistant designed to support complex projects and everyday tasks. It enables users to stay in control as work progresses, ensuring seamless continuity across various activities. The tool aims to enhance productivity by maintaining context and managing tasks efficiently."

items.summary: OpenAI的Dots是一款主动式助手，能在复杂项目和日常任务中持续工作。它帮助用户在任务推进时保持掌控力。

items.title: How we will do better for Australia
items.content: OpenAI apologises for incidents involving Australian government websites and outlines stronger safeguards and support to strengthen Australia’s cyber defences.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI apologises for incidents involving Australian government websites and outlines stronger safeguards and support to strengthen Australia’s cyber defences.

summaries.zh: OpenAI就涉及澳大利亚政府网站的事件道歉，并承诺加强安全措施和支持，以提升澳大利亚的网络安全防御能力。
summaries.en: OpenAI apologizes for incidents targeting Australian government websites and commits to enhancing cybersecurity safeguards. The organization pledges increased support to bolster Australia’s digital defenses, addressing past vulnerabilities and preventing future breaches.

items.summary: OpenAI就涉及澳大利亚政府网站的事件道歉，并承诺加强安全措施和支持，以提升澳大利亚的网络安全防御能力。

items.title: Towards safety cases for frontier AI training
items.content: Our early guidelines for safety cases in frontier AI training cover technical safeguards, operational practices, and investigating misalignment incidents
items.contentSnippet: Our early guidelines for safety cases in frontier AI training cover technical safeguards, operational practices, and investigating misalignment incidents

summaries.zh:
文章标题：《迈向前沿人工智能训练的安全案例》  
文章内容摘要：本文提出的早期安全指南涵盖前沿AI训练中的技术保障措施、操作实践以及错位事件调查。指南旨在通过明确的技术和操作手段，确保AI训练过程的安全性和可控性。
summaries.en: The article outlines early guidelines for safety cases in frontier AI training, focusing on technical safeguards, operational practices, and investigating misalignment incidents. These guidelines aim to ensure safety and alignment in advanced AI systems. The content provides a foundational framework for addressing potential risks associated with frontier AI training.

items.summary:
文章标题：《迈向前沿人工智能训练的安全案例》  
文章内容摘要：本文提出的早期安全指南涵盖前沿AI训练中的技术保障措施、操作实践以及错位事件调查。指南旨在通过明确的技术和操作手段，确保AI训练过程的安全性和可控性。

items.title: The Lenfest Institute grows landmark program with expanded OpenAI support
items.content: OpenAI is expanding the Lenfest AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program with $5 million in funding and up to $5 million in software credits and engineering support.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI is expanding the Lenfest AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program with $5 million in funding and up to $5 million in software credits and engineering support.

summaries.zh: 莱文斯特学院扩大了与OpenAI合作的标志性项目，获得500万美元资金支持，并提供高达500万美元的软件积分和工程支持。该项目旨在促进人工智能领域的合作与创新。
summaries.en: The Lenfest Institute has expanded its AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program with additional support from OpenAI. The partnership includes $5 million in funding, up to $5 million in software credits, and engineering support. This enhancement aims to further develop and advance the program's goals.

items.summary: 莱文斯特学院扩大了与OpenAI合作的标志性项目，获得500万美元资金支持，并提供高达500万美元的软件积分和工程支持。该项目旨在促进人工智能领域的合作与创新。

items.title: Basis completes a tax workbook 2x faster with GPT-6 Astra
items.content: GPT-6 Astra completed a 50-tab tax workbook twice as fast as GPT-5.6 Sol, and its stronger understanding of user intent gives Basis more confidence in real-world use.
items.contentSnippet: GPT-6 Astra completed a 50-tab tax workbook twice as fast as GPT-5.6 Sol, and its stronger understanding of user intent gives Basis more confidence in real-world use.

summaries.zh: Basis公司使用GPT-6 Astra完成了一份包含50个标签的税务工作簿，速度是GPT-5.6 Sol的两倍。GPT-6 Astra对用户意图的理解更强，使Basis在现实应用中更有信心。
summaries.en: Basis achieved a 50-tab tax workbook completion rate twice as fast with GPT-6 Astra compared to GPT-5.6 Sol. GPT-6 Astra's improved understanding of user intent also enhances Basis's confidence in real-world applications.

items.summary: Basis公司使用GPT-6 Astra完成了一份包含50个标签的税务工作簿，速度是GPT-5.6 Sol的两倍。GPT-6 Astra对用户意图的理解更强，使Basis在现实应用中更有信心。
